decisions.statement: Calling a command with text matching a subcommand alias calls that subcommand.
The text after the matched alias is handed on to the subcommand.
Calling a command with no callback raises an error.
An alias added to a command is added to the parent as a subcommand alias.
A command already carrying a parent may not be given a second parent.
Registering the first subcommand turns completion on for the parent.
Unregistering the last subcommand turns completion off again.

definition: one slash command, its aliases, its callback and the commands beneath it
